about: A sparse mirror of the games.fun repository at one commit: the kits games are built on and the tools that create and verify them. Written by scripts/sync-kits.mjs; never edited by hand (fix the kit in games.fun and sync again). tests/kits.test.mjs checks kits/ against this file.

policy.libraryRule: a library file ships when its LICENSES.json record is CC0 or a permissive licence, or it is generated by games.fun; never Meshy output (licence tier unconfirmed) or a file without a record
policy.secrets: no .env files; text files are scanned for key-shaped strings and the sync fails on any hit

sources.why: gf-three API: what rules.js and config are written against
gf-three kit, vendored into each game as gf/three/
gf-three tools: create, verify, slots, catalog, serve, upgrade, play, promises, meshy-*
props, bodies, clips and textures (CC0 or permissive only; no Meshy output)
gf-audio 1.5.0, vendored into each game as audio/
the loudness meter the audio gate v4 imports (its frozen targets)
gf-multiplayer 1.3.0, vendored into each game as gf/mp/
the multiplayer bar every game meets
how a live game shares its world
local game server with signaling (verify, play)
multiplayer.json validation and the kit file list
the two-player gate for live games (verify check 5)
gf-multiplayer dev sources (tools read declarations through them)
ws 8.21.3, vendored by the signal server
